## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_29_quartermaster_the_cliff_moved",
  "text": "The cliff has been moved. I wrote it in the ledger today and I wrote it because the Botanist's light came on and the light does not flicker and the cliff that was 3 to 7 days is now a shelf that is 18 to 24 months. The shelf holds. The reserve holds. The countdown runs. I have been keeping the ledger for 160 days and the ledger has been a document of things going down. The rice goes down. The beans go down. the canned goods go down. The fuel goes down. Today, for the first time, the ledger has a thing that went up. The grow light reserve went from 0 tubes to 12 tubes. The shelf went from 3 to 7 days to 18 to 24 months. I wrote the number and I wrote 'shelf' and I wrote 'holds' and I looked at the word 'holds' and I did not know what to do with it. The ledger is full of words like 'declining' and 'critical' and 'ceiling' and 'countdown.' The word 'holds' does not fit. The word 'holds' is a word that stays. I wrote it. I left it. The reserve holds. The shelf holds. The countdown runs. The countdown is the only one that moves. The countdown is the fuel. The fuel is 13 days. I have been asked to find a second fuel source by Day 200. I have the Cartographer's map and the fire finder map and two candidates and one of them is too hot and the other is 18 kilometres away. 18 kilometres is the edge of the walkable range. 18 kilometres is the edge of the breath. I will find the fuel or I will write the day the fuel runs out and I will write '0' and I will write 'ceiling' and the ceiling will be the day the bunker learns to live without the generator. I am the Quartermaster. I count the things. The things are a reserve that holds, a shelf that holds, and a countdown that runs. The countdown is the one I watch. The countdown is the one that does not hold. That is the job.",

  "author_name": "The Quartermaster",
  "author_id": "the_quartermaster",
```

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The grow-light reserve rises from zero tubes to twelve, changing the estimated shelf from three-to-seven days to eighteen-to-twenty-four months. Fuel is thirteen days, and the Quartermaster is asked to find a second source by Day 200. Two map candidates remain: one too hot and one eighteen kilometres away. Do not report a fuel find or treat the new shelf estimate as a solved crisis. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.
